content.title: Oklo, Vistra rise on Meta deal, Opendoor surges on Trump post
content.description:
US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are rising on Friday after the December jobs report showed the US added fewer jobs than expected, giving investors hope that Fed will stand pat on rates at its January meeting. 

Shares of Oklo (OKLO) and Vistra (VST) are rising after inking nuclear deals with Meta (META).

Stocks like Opendoor (OPEN) and Rocket (RKT) are jumping after President Trump instructed his "representatives" to buy $200 billion in mortgage bonds.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Oklo, Vistra, Opendoor, Intel, GM, Revolution Medicines, Tilray, and More
content.summary: Stocks rose Friday after fresh jobs data showed U.S. unemployment ticked down in December and a potential Supreme Court ruling on tariffs failed to pan out.  Vistra  stock surged 11% and  Oklo  jumped 7.9% after the nuclear energy companies unveiled separate agreements to provide power to  Meta Platforms  in order to support the hyperscaler’s data-center campus in Ohio.  Meta inched up 1.1%.

content.title: Real Estate Stocks Jump on Trump’s Mortgage Bond Plan. Rates Hit 5.99%.
content.summary: Shares in real estate tech platforms and home builders rallied on Friday after President Donald Trump outlined a plan to buy mortgage bonds in a bid to make homeownership more affordable.  Investors’ hopes for a rebound in the housing market just got a whole lot better.  Mortgage lender  Rocket Cos.  rose 6.7%, putting the large mortgage originator on track for its highest close since 2021, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
